tasks.title: The Drone Interceptor's orbit-and-dash and the Open Space Patrol Drone's drift are pinned by tests
tasks.description: See docs/plans/cmufklb100001p92xs1ey2fb1/3-plan.md §3 step 3, §4 rows test_drone_interceptor.gd and test_patrol_drone.gd. Characterization. Drone Interceptor: zero velocity with no player; ENTER at approach_speed toward the player; switches to ORBIT at <= orbit_radius; orbit correction speed clamped to [60, orbit_correct_speed]; the dash starts within [1.0, 2.0] s of ORBIT entry (seed-robust window, not an exact seeded time); the dash direction uses player.velocity * dash_prediction_time; dash_speed; contact sets health to 0; facing converges nose-up toward the target. Assertions must be seed-robust (review F10), because after t14 the draws come from brain.rng: assert the orbit by distance from the player (radius), not by angle, and the dash onset as a window checked over several seeds. Also pin that with no player at dash onset the dash goes straight down, and (in a world with an ArenaCamera at (640,360)) that the dash ends when the drone leaves camera global_position ± viewport/2 ± 80. PatrolDrone: drift = initial_direction * move_speed; a zero direction falls back to RIGHT; scene-wired damage decreases health; health 0 → died + freed. Pin, marked as characterization of a bug: HurtBox mask == 64 (the player's rockets pass through it) and body layer 256. These tests become the port's acceptance test in t14-port-interceptor.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria:
- The tests assert on public observable state (velocity, position, rotation, health, freed), not on private _phase names or RNG draw order, so they survive the t14 port unchanged apart from setup.
- Boundary: at exactly orbit_radius the drone switches to ORBIT; no dash at 1.0 s minus one frame after ORBIT entry, and a dash by 2.0 s plus one frame, for several seeds.
- No production files are changed. The existing gates stay green (config isolation, contact-damage, contact-hitbox and hurtbox geometry, player-bullet lifetime, signal arity, project load integrity, station family). `bash /agent/verify.sh` passes.

tasks.description: See docs/plans/cmufklb100001p92xs1ey2fb1/3-plan.md §2.6 and P-11. Add global/enemy_ai/target_info.gd (class_name TargetInfo extends RefCounted). tasks.title: In Assault, AI-driven enemies stay inside the play corridor with soft edges, and can still fly in from off-screen without being teleported
tasks.description: See docs/plans/cmufklb100001p92xs1ey2fb1/3-plan.md §2.5, §2.5a, P-7 and P-13. Add assault/scenes/systems/assault_corridor_constraint.gd (extends MovementConstraint). Add ArenaCamera.enemy_movement_constraint() returning a new instance per call — the ONLY edit to arena_camera.gd in this task; the group and the other provider methods already exist from t4b.
